name: Kaziranga National Park
about: The park closes entirely during monsoon flooding (roughly May–Oct), reopening for dry-season game drives Nov–Apr.
overview: One-horned rhino stronghold — jeep and elephant safaris through Assam's grasslands and wetlands, one of India's great wildlife reserves.
costOverview: Kaziranga is far cheaper than an African safari — a full thali meal costs just a few dollars, and even the marquee jeep safari to see one-horned rhinos stays affordable split among a group.

specialSeasons.text: Dry-season grass cutting improves visibility for spotting the park's one-horned rhinos.
